director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
haan, samajh aaya

Roti aadhi modi, ek aadhe par ghee lagaya. Kaagaz ki patti par yahi: beech se modi, toh 2 barabar hisse; rang wala hissa patti ka 1/2 hai. Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

director.text: 1 sahi nahi hai. Rang wala aadha pehli patti ka ek bada hissa hai, par doosri patti ke hisse chhote hain; ek bade hisse mein kai chhote hisse aate hain. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, 10 hisson wali doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

director.text: paanch hisse

Haan, sahi hai. 10 hisson ka aadha 5 hisse hai. Ab wahi patti ek baar aur modi, toh 4 barabar hisse bane. Rang wala aadha ab 2 hisson mein hai, yaani 2/4; rang utna hi raha, isliye 1/2 = 2/4. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

director.text: Nahi, 2 theek nahi. Nayi patti ke hisse pehli patti ke hisson se chhote hain. Isliye utni hi jagah rangne ke liye 2 se zyada hisse lagenge. 12 hisson wali patti mein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna ho?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

director.text: chhah

Bilkul sahi: 4 × 3 = 12, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap mein kati hai. Beech ka mark 4/8 hai, aur wahi 1/2 bhi hai aur 2/4 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek jagah, teen naam. Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: six

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki line par har 1/4 mein 1/8 wale 2 gap hain, toh 3/4 tak 3 × 2 = 6 gap, yaani 6/8. Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Sana ek rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe mein rang bharti hai. Phir use do baar aur aadha modti hai. Teeno mod ke baad rumal kholo, toh kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?

seams.form: Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: 8 hisse
Haan, kholne par 8 barabar hisse dikhenge. Rumal ke 8 barabar hisse hain, toh har chhota hissa poore rumal ka 1/8 hai. Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: 8 sahi nahi hai. Kholne par rumal ke kul hisse 8 hain. Par rang modne se phailta nahi: woh sirf usi aadhe ke chhote hisson par rehta hai jismein pehle bhara tha. Kholne par rumal ke 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang hoga?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: Nahi, 8 theek nahi. Pehle mod ke baad rang ek aadhe mein tha. Agle do mod ne us rang wale aadhe ko bhi kaata; socho woh kitne hisson mein bata. Ab tum batao.
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: aadhe hisson mein

Haan, sahi hai. Hisse badle, par rumal par rang utna hi raha. Toh poora jawab: kholne par 8 barabar hisse hain aur 4 mein rang, yaani 4/8, jo 1/2 ke barabar hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Do ek jaisi chocolate hain. Mohit ne ek chocolate ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar khaya?
director.card: Do ek jaisi chocolate hain. Mohit ne ek chocolate ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar khaya?

director.text: dono ne

Bilkul sahi: 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 hisse 3/6 hain, aur 3/6 = 1/2, isliye dono ne barabar khaya. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

director.text: pata nahi

Pehle dhoondo ki 12 gap wali line ka beech, yaani 1/2, kaunse mark par aata hai. Phir 5/12 ka mark dhoondkar usse milaao. 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap wali line par, 5/12 aur 1/2 mein: 5/12 bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
director.card: Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Line ki jagah yahan do barabar lambi patti hain: upar wali beech se do hisson mein bati hai, neeche wali chhote barabar hisson mein. Apna jawab tum khud bolo.
director.card: Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

director.text: 1/2 bada hai

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 5/12 is line par paanchve mark par hai, aur 1/2 = 6/12 chhatthe mark par, isliye 5/12 chhota hai. Modne par 1/2 se 2/4 bana: kul hisse aur rang wale hisse, dono dugne hue, aur rang utna hi raha. Ab bina mode, guna karke barabar fraction banayenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?

Haan, sahi hai. Har rang wala hissa 2 bana, toh 4. Is patti mein rang 4/10 hai, aur yahi 2/5 bhi hai. Neeche 5 × 2 = 10 aur upar 2 × 2 = 4: dono ek hi number se guna hue. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

director.text: 10/6 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh kul hisse bhi dugne hote hain aur rang wale hisse bhi. Isliye upar aur neeche, dono number 2 se guna hote hain, koi ek nahi. 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: do

Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?

director.text: beech wala

Haan, bilkul theek. 2/4 = 1/2 = 3/6, yaani 0 ke baad 3 gap; 1/3 sirf 2 gap par hai. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain. Neha ko 3/5 ke barabar do fraction likhne hain: ek jiska neeche wala number 10 ho, aur ek jiska 15. Neeche 5 se 10 bana. Upar ke 3 ke saath kya karoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain.

director.text: guna karo 2 se

Haan, upar ke 3 ko bhi 2 se guna karna hoga. Upar 3 × 2 = 6 hua, toh 3/5 aur 6/10 barabar hain. Ab doosra fraction: uska neeche wala number 15 hai. 3/5 ke barabar is fraction ka upar wala number kya hoga?
director.card: Ab doosra fraction: uska neeche wala number 15 hai. 3/5 ke barabar is fraction ka upar wala number kya hoga?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. 3/15 mein rang sirf 3 chhote hisson mein hai, jo 3/5 se bahut kam hai: kaatne par rang wale hisson ki ginti bhi badhti hai. Neeche 15 ho, toh 3/5 ke barabar fraction ka upar wala number kya hoga?

director.text: Nahi, 3 theek nahi. Pehle dekho ki neeche ka number kis number se guna hokar 15 banta hai. Phir upar ke number ke saath wahi karo. Ab tumhari baat sunti hoon.

director.text: Haan, sahi hai: har baar upar-neeche dono ek hi guna se badhe: pehle dugne, phir tigune. Toh poora jawab: upar ke number 6 aur 9 aaye, yaani 6/10 aur 9/15. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. 1/3 ke barabar ek naya fraction banana hai, jiska neeche wala number 12 ho. Is naye fraction mein upar kaunsa number aayega?

director.card: 1/3 ke barabar ek naya fraction banana hai, jiska neeche wala number 12 ho. Is naye fraction mein upar kaunsa number aayega?

director.text: chaar
Bilkul sahi, kyunki neeche 3 × 4 = 12 hua, toh upar bhi 1 × 4 = 4, yaani 1/3 = 4/12. Ek fraction 3/4 ke barabar hai, aur uska neeche 8 hai. Upar kaunsa number likhoge?
director.card: Ek fraction 3/4 ke barabar hai, aur uska neeche 8 hai. Upar kaunsa number likhoge?

director.text: chhe
Haan, bilkul theek. 8 hisse banane ke liye har hissa do mein bata, toh 3 rang wale hisse 3 × 2 = 6 ho gaye. 1/4 ke barabar kaunsa fraction hai: 1/12, 3/12 ya 9/12?
director.card: 1/4 ke barabar kaunsa fraction hai: 1/12, 3/12 ya 9/12?

director.text: three twelfths

Sahi jawab, kyunki neeche 4 × 3 = 12, toh upar 1 × 3 = 3, yaani 3/12; 1/12 mein upar guna nahi hua. Ab barabar fraction banana aa gaya. Ab ulta kaam: do fraction diye hon, toh kaise pata karein ki woh barabar hain ya nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?
